newsitem.title: UK: AIC says plans sell over 160,000 t gas oil in ARA.
newsitem.headline: AIC says plans sell over 160,000 t gas oil in ARA.

text.p: Trading house AIC said on Monday Cargill had failed to lift between 160,000 and 190,000 tonnes of gas oil during the November 15-30 IPE delivery.

An AIC spokesman said he would have to sell the product into the ARA barge market in order to mitigate what he called his company's damage arising out of the contract. He added the matter was now in the hands of the International Petroleum Exchange.

He said Cargill had taken all of the product slated for the final Nov 26-30 window but had failed to lift around 160,000 to 190,00 tonnes of the product due to have been exchanged in the first two windows.
